text: Do not penalize a legitimate German product term merely because it differs from a literal English translation when it is natural in e-commerce usage.
Flag untranslated or poorly localized search terms in German Etsy listings when they reduce native-sounding discoverability for German buyers.
Check size or measurement values against German market conventions and convert them when a U.S. format would confuse buyers.
Flag mixed-language product phrases that sound unnatural in German, even if the underlying translation is broadly correct.
Do not lower factual accuracy for added Etsy tag text when the core translated product information remains correct and complete.
Treat failure to convert imperial measurements into metric units as a localization error that can materially hurt German buyer comprehension and search relevance.
Flag unnatural German phrasings even when the translation is otherwise accurate, and lower the score if they would sound awkward to native buyers.
Treat missing metric conversions as a localization error when German buyers would expect centimeter-based measurements instead of U.S. units.
Penalize leftover English or mixed-language search terms in German Etsy listings when they are not clearly appropriate for local e-commerce use.
Penalize catastrophic mistranslations that turn a source term into a dangerous or unrelated German meaning, especially when the error would mislead buyers.
Lower factual accuracy when a translation misses a critical compound or numeral meaning and turns it into the wrong quantity or concept in German.
Flag unnatural German phrasing even when the core translation is correct, if the wording would sound awkward to native German e-commerce buyers.
